items.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: when we came up there to do his jazz party, he insisted, on, “I have a good piano player for you.” I said, “I’m the piano player.”

ctx.x: I mean, I knew the answer to that because I could tell. © Fillius Jazz Archive -31-
Well a lot of people didn’t. Because Dick, up in Denver that used to do the jazz parties?
